issue.title: PITR causes masters to fail on two of three nodes after attempting a recovery

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
When attempting to do a Point In Time Recovery ( PITR ) on both the YSQL and YCQL side following the instructions online my system ends up in a failure state where two out of three masters cannot start

Attempting to do a PITR backup and recovery on my test cluster and it causes it to go into a failed state, this is the process

```

{
    "schedule_id": "7242637a-bae8-4df3-9964-faa46d15f67b"
}

{

}

yugabyte=# \q

You have new mail in /var/spool/mail/yugabyte
[yugabyte@yugacloud01 ~]$
```
